<!-- pr-reviewer: b20e12ace91e9ab467fd7793bc5e3051f8dbb75e -->
Ready for the maintainer to merge.

## What looks good

- Display only, as the issue asks: `Tool::profile`, the collision envelope, toolpaths, simulation and posted output do not change. The tooth crests stay inside the crest cylinder, so the plain mesh box is unchanged.
- New module is private to the window (`crates/ui/src/egui_app/tool_library_dialog/thread_form.rs`), with a one-line provenance comment, and the `model.rs` module doc names the change.
- The decision is recorded in `docs/decisions/4451-thread-mill-preview.md` (decided / why / dropped / cost), the pinning tests are inline in the same module (no new top-level test binary), and the body carries `Changelog:` and `Fixes #4451`.
- The 4 pinning tests pin the tooth counts, the core radius, the neck retention and the kept shank.

## Results merged with main (on the self-hosted runner)

Run: https://github.com/NeoTech/Camcraft/actions/runs/46077308056 (main `3c7cbe86056cdf306c7bfa6909bc7d5d94088542`, merged tree)

- Trial merge with main: clean ("Trial merge with main (local only, never pushed)" ok).
- Quick gate on the merged tree: 11 steps, 0 failed (ui build ok 205s; ui suites: lib 1810 passed / 0 failed / 8 ignored in 178.91s; boundary 3, boundary_picks 7, contour_dxf_sketch 2, sinker_setup 2, tap_hand 3, theme_example 3, theme_files 34, waterjet_tool 1; site tests skipped - zola/node missing on the runner, environment skip, not a pass).
- Clippy on the touched crates: `cargo clippy -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings` clean (Finished dev profile, no warnings).
- The 4 `thread_form` pinning tests pass on the runner log (`a_multi_form_thread_mill_draws_one_tooth_per_row_on_its_core`, `a_single_form_thread_mill_draws_one_tooth_then_its_neck`, `the_profile_shank_follows_the_teeth`, `other_kinds_and_bad_numbers_draw_no_teeth`).

Local: no extra local suites were owed (runner verdict, no Windows-only readings in the diff, UI built by the runner's own suite).

## Targeted tests

- Example catalog suites: no post or toolpath change - not run (n/a).
- Light lane (`cargo xtask gate light`, locally on this tree): 6 steps, 0 failed, wall 8.7 min (light build 354s, motion lib 61s, adaptive_troch_island 61s, adaptive_troch_neck 22s, adaptive_troch_parallel 18s, app pocket_pass_start 3s).
- Heavy lane: not owed (P3, display only, no safety-floor reach); no `<!-- heavy-wave: -->` record present, which is not a finding.

## Requested before merge

None.

## Notes (non-blocking)

- The Properties side preview (`tool_preview::paint` without a steel override) still draws the crest cylinder; the PR body and the decision file both name this, and #4452 can call `thread_form::toothed` there.
- The runner's lib suite counted 1810 passed + 8 ignored; the body's 2013-vs-2009 count came from the author's own `cargo test` run - not a discrepancy worth chasing.
- Teeth render as a stroked polyline plus a revolved mesh; side-view fills skip `z1 <= z0` windows, so the flute-band fill is convex per slice - cosmetically fine, no law.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
